noura: hey! following up from the community call — you asked whether cache hits get billed. as far as i know cache-hit tokens are billed at 50%, that came up on a panel last month

devon: huh really? the hosted api packages page says cache-hit tokens don't change billed totals unless a contract discounts them. which is right?

noura: honestly not sure, i might be thinking of a different provider. i'd go with the published page, i'm community not billing :sweat_smile:
